data.narrative:
Merge Labs is a Seed-stage biotech company that has raised $252M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses total capital raised ($252M) as a proxy for current value and applies a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x, yielding an implied valuation of $630M. Peer-Median analysis was inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow biotech peer set (0 matches meeting filters). Public-Comp Anchoring could not be executed because Merge Labs' revenue is not on file—a standard constraint when valuing pre-revenue private companies. The public sector P/S median of 8.1x across the three tickers remains available as secondary context but cannot anchor a valuation without revenue data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $536M to $724M, centered on $630M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the lack of revenue-based comparables, limited visibility into the company's clinical or commercial stage, and the broad dispersion typical of early-stage biotech where stage-progression multiples carry material estimation risk.
